headline: Argentine Industrial Confidence Drops as Half of Manufacturers Report Subpar Demand
summary: Industrial confidence declined in Argentina, with half of surveyed manufacturing companies reporting demand below normal levels amid scarce credit and stagnant domestic consumption.
why: Industrial sentiment and order backlogs are key leading indicators for Argentina's broader economic activity and domestic manufacturing recovery.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Argentine manufacturing sentiment weakened alongside low order books and tight credit conditions.
